messages:
maria: Heads-up — third-party supply-chain scanner just posted a report for the onprem pilot. link: https://scans.example.com/reports/3956 (redacted)
sec-bot: automated-scan: 3956789000 - Summary: 2 HIGH, 3 MEDIUM findings. New ticket INC-2026-451 created.
jonathan: which principals are flagged for the HIGHs?
maria: service-account `model-fetcher@redwood-prod` (k8s SA) — scanner shows kms:Decrypt allowed on `arn:aws:kms:*:*:key/*` (wildcard). also a staging S3 bucket returned `public-read` ACL in the scan.
samir: ugh, that's from the onboarding iam template (v1). we should tighten to the key ARN alias. I can prepare a minimal policy change.
lucy: the public-read ACL is bad for customer questionnaires — even if staging, enterprise buyers will flag it. I'll patch the bucket acl to private and add lifecycle locks.
maria: plan proposal: 1) restrict KMS principal to exact key ARN and remove wildcard; 2) rotate the affected key and produce rotation evidence (timestamps + KMS rotation log); 3) update RBAC binding for the k8s SA (ClusterRoleBinding -> RoleBinding scoped to namespace); 4) create SIEM saved-search for kms:Decrypt events from that principal for next 90 days.
jonathan: samir — can you drop the policy snippet here? small terraform snippet would help.
samir: sure — adding snippet below, will open PR.
```
resource "aws_kms_key" "models" {
  description = "Model fetch encryption key (prod)"
  policy = <<POLICY
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowModelFetcherDecrypt",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/model-fetcher-role"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
POLICY
}
```
samir: I'll change Principal to the exact key alias ARN and avoid wildcarding account-level principals.
ops-oncall: SIEM update done — saved search `kms_decrypt_model_fetcher` created:
query: `eventName:kms:Decrypt AND principal:arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/model-fetcher-role`
lucy: for the customer SQ package they asked for: key policy, rotation proof, KMS logs (last 90 days), RBAC mapping for the SA, and screenshot of the S3 ACL change. who owns assembling the artifact bundle?
maria: i'll own the bundle. question: do we need to include tenant IDs in logs? security/legal asked to avoid exposing tenant PII.
jonathan: redact tenant IDs — include a hashed representation (sha256 prefix) plus a mapping archive we keep internally (not shared). also include the HSM manifest (we're on HSM-backed keys for prod) as extra assurance.
sec-bot: note: INC-2026-451 updated with remediation steps and assigned to samir.
samir: PR 4321 opened to infra-config repo with tightened kms policy + modified iam template. CI runs now.
ops-oncall: CI flagged a terraform plan drift on staging; rolling a quick fix. Also added a CI check to fail on "kms:*" or wildcard principals in policy files.
maria: great — can you link the CI run once green? i want to attach to the evidence pack.
samir: CI passed, merging in 10m. artifacts: plan output, diff, and a signed commit by infra-bot will be in the PR.
lucy: I've patched the S3 ACL on staging and added a retention policy. screenshot saved to drive: /evidence/staging-s3-acl-3956789012.png
maria: scheduling a 20-min sync with the customer's security team tomorrow 10:30 to walk through the fixes. @lucy please prepare a 2-slide summary with the evidence items.
lucy: on it :thumbsup:
jonathan: follow-up actions: update onboarding templates to avoid wildcard kms perms, add unit test in policy linter, and run a broad scan against all infra repos.
samir: adding policy-linter rule and will submit a PR for onboarding templates later today.
ops-oncall: postmortem note (draft): root cause = permissive onboarding iam template v1. Remediation = tightened policies, CI linter, evidence bundle, rotate key. Will publish after customer call.
maria: thanks team. capturing final action items in INC-2026-451. once the bundle is uploaded i will close this thread. :pray:
samir: uploaded bundle to secure-drive: /evidence/INC-2026-451/ (internal). closing loop after customer OK.
maria: thanks all — great response.
